author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This episode brings together past videos of cooking with spring blossoms into one long compilation.

In Yunnan, spring is the perfect season for eating flowers.

These blossoms may look simple, but each carries its own distinct flavor.
Some are slightly bitter, some gently sweet, some delicately fresh, and some quietly fragrant.
When you taste them, it feels not only like eating the flower itself, but also like tasting the freshness of the season.

These are not flavors you can have all year round.
They only appear for a short time in spring—at their freshest, most tender, and most memorable.
That’s why, every year when the season comes, there’s always a desire to hold on to this taste of spring.

Bringing all these spring blossoms together in this video feels like reliving the season once more.
Flowers bloom in their time, and fade in their time—
to taste them at their very best is something truly precious.
